newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NSW govt says no decision on casino tax yet.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NSW govt says no decision on casino tax yet.

text.p: The New South Wales (NSW) state government said on Tuesday it had made no decision yet on a tax concession sought by Sydney Harbour Casino Ltd for high roller gamblers.
"We have made no decision yet. It hasn't gone to cabinet yet," said Michael Coutts-Trotter, a spokesman for NSW Treasurer Micheal Egan.
Sydney Harbour Casino Ltd shares were up nine cents or over four percent at A$2.15 in mid afternoon trading.
Some analysts said the rise was due to the NSW government nearing a decision on the casino tax concession.
The Sydney casino is seeking a 10 percent tax rate concession for the high roller market from the government.
Brokers have said that Sydney Harbour Casino shares would rise sharply if the concession were granted by the government.
